items.q: Dave Kapp was a liberal sort of a man, and Jack Kapp had been around Chicago... They come to New York and they opened Decca, Decca Records

ctx.x: them... Dave Kapp was a liberal sort of a man, and Jack Kapp had been around Chicago, around Paramount Records and all that... They come to New York and they opened Decca, Decca Records, and they picked up all the artists of Victor and Columbia. They were particular who they'd record, see. And Decca, they come on with their thing.. So they got a guy named Mel Williams, who is a bandit. He robbed you. He wouldn't give no royalties.
